disposition: A typed error adapter exists: host/TerraBase.Api/TypedApi.cs Failure/SchemaFailure map typed TBEP codes onto 400/401/403/409/410/422/500/501/502/503 with a {code,message} envelope, exercised by focused gate/session/supervision tests. The V1 {Url,Type,Message,Error} envelope shape, the 408-timeout, 425-TooEarly, and moved-database-410-with-cache-control mappings, and full client exception dispatch parity are absent (the C# client surfaces typed TbepException codes only).
